title: 271 Red Cedar Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 271 Red Cedar Way is a 6.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 12)- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- 6 Passenger Street Legal Golf Cart Included in Rental- Private Pool with Spa (complimentary pool heating available October 1-May 1)- Outdoor Fireplace - Natural Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Parking for 2 Vehicles- Quick Bike Ride to Camp Pool- 5 Minute Golf Cart Ride to WaterColor's Beach Club Access- 6 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS: Discover the perfect blend of luxury and coastal charm at 271 Red Cedar Way, a spacious 6-bedroom, 4,270 sqft home in the sought-after Camp District of WaterColor. With designer furnishings, high ceilings, and plenty of natural light, this home offers a serene atmosphere for up to 16 guests. The first floor boasts an open floor plan, including a gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops, a Wolf gas range, and a large kitchen island, flowing into the comfortable living and dining areas. The main floor also includes a laundry room, a half bath, and a king bedroom with an ensuite bathroom. Upstairs, four beautifully decorated bedrooms await, including the lavish master suite with a king bed, soaking tub, and private balcony. The second floor also features two king guest rooms with ensuite bathrooms and balcony access, plus a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks. The third floor offers a versatile space with a king bed, twin bunk beds, and a private bathroom. Outdoor amenities are exceptional, including a private pool and hot tub, spacious porches, and a lounge area perfect for stargazing. Guests enjoy access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and additional community pools, plus kayaking and paddleboarding on nearby Western Lake. This home includes six adult bikes and a 6-seater electric cart, ideal for exploring 30A. Make unforgettable memories at 271 Red Cedar Way—reserve your stay today.
